title: Gent
description: Archaeological remains of a large Roman town that Gsell (AAA) places 10 kilometers east of the Gent farm ("ferme Gent"); so, to judge from his map, on high ground north of the modern Oued Mekkera near the boundary between the communes of Boudjebaa El Bordj and El Gaada in Algeria's Mascara province.

properties.description: 1:1 million scale representative point location digitized from the Barrington Atlas of the Greek and Roman World by the Digital Atlas of Roman and Medieval Civilizations project at Harvard University.
properties.title: DARMC location 12520
